A motorcyclist was thrown off his bike after hitting an unmarked speed breaker on the 130-metre road in Greater Noida West. The incident, captured on a car's dashcam around 11 pm on Wednesday, has gone viral on social media.

The speed breaker reportedly had no white markings or reflectors, making it difficult for motorists to spot it from a distance. Police said they have not received any complaint in connection with the incident.

A video of RJD MLA Naresh Prasad Singh from Palamu, Jharkhand, has gone viral, showing him crossing the Dhuriya river while sitting on a man's shoulders. The two lost their balance and fell into the water midway.

The incident has raised questions over the lack of a bridge, with villagers reportedly demanding one for years. The video also shows another person carrying the MLA's shoe.

posts.summary_zh: 《今日印度》报道，贾坎德邦帕拉穆的RJD议员纳雷什·普拉萨德·辛格坐在一名男子肩上渡Dhuriya河，走到一半两人失去平衡双双落水；视频里还有另一个人帮议员拎着鞋。村民据称多年来一直要求在此修桥。

posts.text:
A biker had a miraculous escape after a wild elephant stepped on him twice on the Haridwar-Dehradun Highway in Uttarakhand. The shocking incident, which took place near Nepali Farm in the early hours of Thursday, was captured on camera and has since gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the incident happened at around 4 am when the biker encountered the elephant on the highway. In a shocking turn of events, the animal stepped on the man's stomach and chest twice, leaving him pinned beneath its feet.

However, what happened next left everyone stunned. Despite the terrifying encounter, the biker managed to get back on his feet immediately after the elephant moved away. He appeared to have escaped without any visible injuries.
